# paper-crumple (vendored)

`paper-vat.js` and the `../../vat/` assets (FBX mesh + EXR position texture) are copied unmodified
from [item-develop/paper-crumple-demo](https://github.com/item-develop/paper-crumple-demo)
at commit `f84648b`, under the MIT license in `LICENSE`.

`paper-vat.js` decodes the Houdini VAT export; `../../src/stage.js` imports it and loads `../../vat/`.
